summary: Judith Basin County, MT: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built 1936 on the Lewis & Clark NF, demolished 1970; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Demolished in 1970 according to firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts marks it removed

evidence.quote: This 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1936, was demolished in 1970.

evidence.supports: about eight miles east of Neihart
elevation 8,846 feet as given by the page
on the Lewis and Clark National Forest
page marks the site as removed
Montana list shows Yogo Peak tower as gone, Judith Basin County
evidence.quote: Yogo Peak Judith Basin 46.92745 -110.54249 Tower Gone

notes_for_editor: The 1936 build and 1970 demolition come only from firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts page says only Removed, and one search found no independent record. Do not merge with Monument Peak, a separate Little Belts L-4 lookout built in 1936 that a search snippet mentioned. News snippets call the forest Helena-Lewis and Clark NF; not verified and not used. The elevation is quoted as the page gives it. No staffing or fire history found.
